name: Apollo Beach Holiday in the Park at the Park and Recreation Center
venue: Apollo Beach Park and Recreation Center
address: 664 Golf and Sea Boulevard, Apollo Beach, FL 33572
paras: Hillsborough County lists Holiday in the Park at the Apollo Beach Park and Recreation Center on Friday, December 18, 2026, from 6 to 8 PM. The county page lists the cost as $1 for ages 5 and older and says no registration is required.

The county describes an annual holiday event for the community and the surrounding areas that has run for over 14 years. It names free food, arts and crafts, gifts, face painting, a photo booth and the chance to take pictures with Santa.
There is no minimum age requirement. Questions go to the county at (813) 981-4201.
tip: Bring a dollar for each child age 5 and up.
